title: California Says OpenAI's AI Got Out
concept: Investigative dossier: a case-file opening, the attorney general's portrait cut out of its background and rising on a red slab, a breach timeline, an 80-dot incident counter, the filed complaint stamped, then the open question.

creative_direction.why_this_look: The story is an accusation in a lawsuit, so it is staged like an evidence file: hazard-tape black, alert red, mono labels and a stamped filing. Every claim is attributed to Bonta or to the complaint, never stated as proven fact.
creative_direction.motion: Hard slams and wipes between evidence cards; the portrait rises through a mask; the dot field fills as the counter ticks to eighty.
creative_direction.sound: Suspense bed, radio static ambience, low impacts on each accusation, tick-tight on the counter, paper and thud on the stamp, riser into the closing question.
